hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
SQL_FILE="${WORKSPACE}/db/dml/rebuild_searchable_fields.sql" if [ ! -f "$SQL_FILE" ]; then echo "ERROR: $SQL_FILE not found. Check SCM checkout." >&2 exit 1 fi
SECRET_ID='rds!db-8086eb77-cd6d-48bc-9298-4380892798ca'
SECRET_JSON=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \ --secret-id "$SECRET_ID" \ --query 'SecretString' \ --output text)
database_psql_host_address='dictionarydb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com'
DB_USER=$(echo "$SECRET_JSON" | jq -r '.username') DB_PASS=$(echo "$SECRET_JSON" | jq -r '.password') DB_HOST="${database_psql_host_address}" DB_PORT=5432 DB_NAME="dictionary_db"
echo "Running rebuild_searchable_fields.sql against ${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME} ..."
docker run --rm -i \ -e PGPASSWORD="$DB_PASS" \ postgres:16-bookworm \ psql -h "$DB_HOST" -p "$DB_PORT" -U "$DB_USER" -d "$DB_NAME" \ -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \ -c "SET search_path TO dict;" \ -f - < "$SQL_FILE"
echo "Searchable fields rebuild complete."
